description: Use when monitoring, diagnosing, or managing Batch Apex, Scheduled Apex, Queueable, and Flow scheduled jobs: Setup > Apex Jobs, AsyncApexJob queries, concurrent limits, failure detection, and notification patterns. NOT for writing the Batch or Schedulable class itself — use apex/batch-apex-patterns or apex/apex-scheduled-jobs. NOT for BatchApexErrorEvent alerting in code — use apex/scheduled-apex-failure-detection-and-monitoring. Trigger keywords: Setup > Scheduled Jobs, Apex Flex Queue, CronTrigger, CronJobDetail, FlowInterview, System.abortJob, System.schedule, CRON expression, Holding status, BLOCKED state, reschedule after sandbox refresh, scheduled job runbook.
inputs: Job type to monitor: Batch Apex, Scheduled Apex, Queueable, or Flow scheduled job
Whether the issue is a failed job, a delayed job, or a missing notification
name: batch-job-scheduling-and-monitoring
official_sources: Object Reference for the Salesforce Platform — **AsyncApexJob** — https://resources.docs.salesforce.com/262/latest/en-us/sfdc/pdf/object_reference.pdf (JobType and Status restricted picklist values; `NumberOfErrors` counts batches not records; `ExtendedStatus` holds the first error only and full detail is emailed to the last user who modified the class; `ParentJobId` / `BatchApexWorker` chunking; the View Setup and Configuration access rule behind the `Async_Job_Operations` permission set)

Object Reference for the Salesforce Platform — **CronTrigger and CronJobDetail** — https://resources.docs.salesforce.com/262/latest/en-us/sfdc/pdf/object_reference.pdf (the nine `State` values including `BLOCKED` and `PAUSED_BLOCKED`; `NextFireTime`, `TimesTriggered`, `TimeZoneSidKey`, `OwnerId`; the `CronJobDetail.JobType` codes 1/3/4/6/7/8/9/A that separate Scheduled Flow from Scheduled Apex; Supported Calls being query-only, which is the grounding for "a schedule is data, not metadata")

Object Reference for the Salesforce Platform — **FlowInterview** — https://resources.docs.salesforce.com/262/latest/en-us/sfdc/pdf/object_reference.pdf (`InterviewStatus` values, the `Error` field added in API 62.0, and the Manage Flow permission needed to delete an interview — the surface behind monitoring query 3g)

Apex Developer Guide — **Apex Scheduler** and **Holding Batch Jobs in the Apex Flex Queue** — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/atlas.en-us.apexcode.meta/apexcode/apex_scheduler.htm (100 scheduled Apex jobs at one time and how to count them via CronTrigger/CronJobDetail; the `This schedulable class has jobs pending or in progress` deploy error and the delete-deploy-recreate recommendation; sandbox refresh not copying scheduled jobs; the batch status table defining `Completed` as "with or without failure"; flex queue FIFO ordering and the `LimitException` at 100)

Apex Reference Guide — **System Class** (`abortJob`, `schedule`, `scheduleBatch`) and **FlexQueue Class** — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/atlas.en-us.apexref.meta/apexref/apex_methods_system_system.htm (the CronTrigger-Id-vs-AsyncApexJob-Id rule for `abortJob`; abort not stopping in-progress code; the six/seven-field CRON syntax, field ranges, special characters and worked expressions; `scheduleBatch` landing at the end of the flex queue; the four `FlexQueue` reorder methods and the "final statement in a transaction" rule; `System.schedule` using the running user's timezone)

Salesforce Developer Limits and Allocations Quick Reference (App Limits cheat sheet) — https://resources.docs.salesforce.com/262/latest/en-us/sfdc/pdf/salesforce_app_limits_cheatsheet.pdf (5 batch jobs queued or active concurrently; 100 in the flex queue in Holding; 100 Apex classes scheduled concurrently and 5 in Developer Edition; the `DailyAsyncApexExecutions` allocation of 250,000 or licences × 200; "synchronous limits apply to scheduled Apex jobs"; per-transaction limits resetting per batch `execute`; `OrgLimits.getAll()` / `getMap()` as the way to read remaining budget)

Metadata API Developer Guide — **Flow / FlowSchedule / FlowStart** and **PermissionSet** — https://resources.docs.salesforce.com/262/latest/en-us/sfdc/pdf/api_meta.pdf (`schedule` required when `triggerType` is `Scheduled`; the `FlowStartFrequency` values and which are segment-triggered only; `startTime` being based on the org's default time zone; the `userPermissions` / `ViewSetup` shape used in the deployable permission set. The absence of any `CronTrigger` or `CronJobDetail` metadata type in this guide is the negative evidence for section 1 of `metadata-examples.md`)

Salesforce Well-Architected — https://architect.salesforce.com/docs/architect/well-architected/guide/overview.html (Operational Excellence and Reliability framing for the monitoring and registry practices above)

Apex Developer Guide — Using Batch Apex — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/atlas.en-us.apexcode.meta/apexcode/apex_batch_interface.htm (the `finish()` hook and the `Database.BatchableContext.getJobId()` pattern the notification examples rest on — carried over from the original version of this skill)

Apex Developer Guide — Governor Limits — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/atlas.en-us.apexcode.meta/apexcode/apex_gov_limits.htm (per-transaction limit behaviour for batch vs scheduled Apex — carried over from the original version of this skill)

Salesforce Help — Monitor Apex Jobs — https://help.salesforce.com/s/articleView?id=sf.code_apex_job_monitor.htm&type=5 (the Setup > Apex Jobs UI itself — carried over from the original version of this skill; help.salesforce.com could not be fetched during this revision, so every behavioural claim above is grounded in the PDF guides instead)
outputs: SOQL query to retrieve AsyncApexJob status for the target job
Explanation of the job's current status and relevant limits
Failure notification pattern if not already implemented
